page.overview:
What is Goat Horn?

A goat horn is an item dropped by goats. It has eight variants, and each plays a unique sound when which can be heard by players in a large radius.

A goat horn is dropped when an adult goat rams a tree or any other hard block that occurs naturally where goats spawn. These include stone, coal ore, copper ore, iron ore, emerald ore, log, or packed ice. Goats do not ram other solid blocks. , these blocks are listed under the tag, and can be modified by data packs.

Up to two goat horns can be dropped from an adult goat. Regular goats drop the Ponder, Sing, Seek, and Feel goat horns, while screaming goats drop the Admire, Call, Yearn, and Dream goat horns. A specific goat drops only one type of goat horn; that is, if a goat drops a Sing horn, its other horn is also a Sing horn.

Only the four variants from regular goats can be found here.
